t: The Mind of the Universe: The Player
d: Humans and animals play and this renders them familiar with their environments. We zoom in on scientists who combine play and mathematics, and see how playing with matter yields new materials with special properties.

t: The Biblical Plagues: Darkness over Egypt

t: Operation Peter Pan - The Secret War against Cuba
d: The documentary tells the story of unknown historical events of Cuban history and asks the question whether or not the US lead a secret war against their socialistic neighbour.

Medics aren't always available on the battlefield, so military leaders have developed specialized medical training for all soldiers, known as Combat Casualty Care, because IEDs and other types of bombs are wounding far too many personnel.

High technology is changing the modern battlefield. It is also changing training. In this episode, we examine the different types of simulators and other related technology that is being used to help make soldiers more battle-ready.

st: Inside the Metropolitan Museum, New York

t: The Mind of the Universe: The Explorer
d: The explorer peers beyond our known borders and discloses the unknown. We will get a glimpse of the secrets of life, both on earth and elsewhere in the universe, and zoom in on the peculiar history of our own planet. What are the borders yet to cross?
